notes.title: Game Launch Announcement & Update Notice
notes.content:
Sorry for the low quality of the material.
However, we will immediately start to reset the art and music materials in the game. In addition, our script is also undergoing major revisions. According to the internal testers, the new version of the script will be twice as interesting as the currently released version~!
In addition, there will be some changes to the game interface, and the new UI will be smoother and smoother, so stay tuned.
The next version is expected to be launched in October 2022. Due to the dramatic changes in the script, it may not be able to inherit the archive of the previous version. Apologies here.
